prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 服务器安全基线核查记录 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "受检服务器唯一编号" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 138px
  col 2: header "系统账户口令强度" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 3: header "外部网络访问开放" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 4: header "日志留存天数达标" · longest unbreakable word 28px · one-line width 123px
  col 5: header "漏洞补丁更新状态" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 6: header "高危端口关闭数量" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 7: header "近三十天告警次数" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 8: header "应急联系人确认情况" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 138px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"服务器安全基线核查记录：用六台服务器逐行对照七项安全基线检查，便于核查合规情况，并比较不同服务器在哪些检查项上失败。","reading":"先按第1列识别服务器（01–06），再从左到右横向扫过七项检查；同时也会纵向比较同一检查项在不同服务器上的取值，因此检查列应保持可比、对齐。长表头必须换行，短数据值不应换行。","groups":["第1列是行标识，只负责标识服务器，不应与检查项混同。","第2–3列是账户口令与外部访问的二元控制项，数据同为“是/否”，可以共用最窄的宽度。","第4–7列是量化或状态证据：留存天数、补丁状态、端口数量、告警次数；这些列要容纳数字和状态，其中第4列需要最宽以保住三位数天数。","第8列是联系人确认项，虽然也是二元值，但表头最长，应比纯二元列略宽。"],"keep_intact":["第1列的服务器编号 01–06","第2、3、5、8列的“是/否”值","第4列的三位留存天数（最长 28px，不可断开）","第6–7列的一至两位计数（16px）","所有表头文字，按字换行但不裁切"],"may_wrap":["第1–8列的长表头，尤其第2–8列；表头行可以增高","第1列表头可纵向堆叠","数据单元格应保持单行，不应换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [48, 44, 44, 49, 44, 44, 44, 42] · table 360×441px · row heights [222, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [55, 37, 37, 50, 37, 45, 46, 50] · table 358×441px · row heights [222, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [58, 38, 38, 58, 38, 38, 38, 53] · table 360×418px · row heights [199, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Constraint adjustments applied: r0B: raised a column to the minimum 38px; raised a column to the minimum 38px; raised a column to the minimum 38px; scaled down from 365px to fit 359px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"Every data cell stays on one line, all six server rows read as clean units, and the pink box is filled exactly; the row banding and 36px row height give a steady rhythm for the data area.","problems":"The header is a solid wall of vertical single characters — all eight headers are 8–9 line stacks and the header block (222px) is taller than the six data rows combined (216px), so the table reads as text art rather than a header.
